The '''''TurboDyne'' 99-U''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] engine produced by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. It was piloted by [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]].

==Characteristics==
The TurboDune 99-U was a surprisingly maneuverable Podracer considering its size. Boasting strong acceleration, traction and airbrakes it could handle winding courses well. It also had a good boost package to compensate for its slightly lacking top speed, though its repair mechanism left something to be desired.<ref name="Prima Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
